liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Morning Dew** (3 reviews): Reviewer, accidentally dosed heavily, could only form full sentences by the middle of this song; Attendee says it stunned the crowd, and people were still discussing it outside hours later [10][13][14]
- **Eyes of the World** (2 reviews): Attendee recalls Jerry breaking a string during this song; Reviewer ranks it among the three best songs, with Dew and Brokedown [16][20]
- **Brokedown Palace** (2 reviews): Reviewer laments the encore is missing from the official release; Reviewer's all-time favorite encore [12][17]
- **Althea** (1 review): Reviewer's favorite Althea ever, with a closing jam both chill and electrifying, now officially released [12]

## The recordings

- **gd1980-05-16.126718.mtx.dusborne.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 23 songs; 168 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls this matrix superb [20]
- **gd1980-05-16.111170.fob.glassberg.motb-0164.flac16**: audience recording; 23 songs; 171 min; rated 4/5 by 2 [6]. Said about its sound: Audience recording by Barry is praised as top-notch and smoking [17]
- **gd80-05-16.sbd.clugston.7472.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 22 songs; 149 min; rated 4/5 by 14 [7]. Said about its sound: Soundboard is a fairly decent mix, though the source (multitrack or straight board) is unclear [11]
- **gd1980-05-16.126104.ecm280.wise.minches.flac2496**: audience recording; 23 songs; 164 min [2]

## Around the show

- Fans rode a school bus from Long Branch, NJ; this was the third of three Nassau nights [10]
- Reviewer judged this the best night musically of the three Nassau shows [10]
- About half the show is on Go To Nassau, whose sound is judged better than this soundboard [11]
- Another Morning Dew from 10/14/80 is also great; Rochester 9/2/80 is called the year's best [13]
- First half of second set was Go To Heaven material, which was overplayed on this tour and felt boring [14]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1980-05-16.126718.mtx.dusborne.flac16**: transferred by Matrix by Dave Usborne; source: 2 source matrix by Dusborne; Soundboard (shnid:89473) Source 1: Master Soundboard Cassette > Cassette > DAT> CDR (s101-s211) Source 2: Unknown nth generation… [1]
- **gd1980-05-16.111170.fob.glassberg.motb-0164.flac16**: taped by Barry Glassberg; source: Source: FOB Audience Recording Media: MAC = Maxell UDXLII; [6]
- **gd80-05-16.sbd.clugston.7472.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [7]. Also: Reviewer once had an incomplete analog copy taken from a King Biscuit Flour Hour radio broadcast [12]
- **gd1980-05-16.126104.ecm280.wise.minches.flac2496**: taped by Jim Wise; transferred by David Minches; source: Recording by Jim Wise: Master Audience Cassette; 2 Sony ECM-280s > Sony D-5; Transfer and FLAC encoding by David Minches: Master played back on Nakamichi… [2]
